about_the_game:
(FULL GAME) [COMING SOON]

After years of not getting answers about your sister's DEATH, you decide to take things into your own hands and find out what REALLY happened.

You know what they told you was a LIE.

A way to keep the people from looking deeper.

Even after the place closed down you were never fully satisfied so you break into their old build searching for CLUES.

Walking down the cold dark hallways alone you find a room.

A room where a desk and an older COMPUTER. You turn it on to see if it still works and that's where your ADVENTURE begins.

short_description: You play as Olivia Sasaki, a new student who moved to Japan all the way from America. Meet new friends and search for lost things, you might just end up finding yourself along the way!
